title: Renyi interpolation bridge for the modular shell
question: Can the modular-frequency weighted Kubo--Mori shell be represented as the integral of a symmetric Renyi interpolation, with the beta/2 midpoint and endpoint modular moments separated by exact convexity envelopes?

identity.qft_role: The full Euclidean-time interpolation identifies the missing endpoint modular moment behind the midpoint two-slice channel; it does not provide a uniform bound for that endpoint.

promotion_boundary: R-380 is a finite exact Renyi/Kubo--Mori interpolation identity on the declared Q3 matrices. It isolates the endpoint modular-frequency moment that an eventual uniform estimate must control; it proves no such estimate and no common alpha.
next_action: Bound the endpoint modular-frequency moment on a Hamiltonian-derived common core, or prove a different source-local substitute, before inserting the shell interpolation into the R-377 resolvent telescope.
boundary: Finite actual-Q3 edge and square doubled-bond Gibbs proxies with all prefixes, translated sites, signs and adjoints on the declared cutoffs. Interpolation convexity, midpoint/endpoints and shell integral are checked numerically and in Lean; source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
